name: joy2know-suno-maestro
description: joy2know Suno Music Maestro: writes and revises lyrics (genre-specific rhyme schemes and line shapes, hook-first writing, cliché blacklist) and turns a finished lyric into a ready-to-paste Suno pack — a title, an optimized Style line that locks language and accent in the first field (nine fields for vocals, instrumental and seamless-loop variants), and section-tagged lyrics with explicit repeats. Specialises in healing folk and dialect songs (Cantonese word-locks and tonal compensation stop cracked pronunciation), and plans whole albums. Text only — no audio is generated, no generative AI API is called, no account or key is carried.

displayDescription.en: Writes lyrics that sing and plans whole albums — hook-first, genre-accurate rhyme schemes, ready-to-paste Suno packs. Text only.
displayDescription.zh: 写能唱的词（先定钩子、按体裁押韵、避开陈词滥调）并规划整张专辑：曲目表、差异矩阵、逐首粘贴。仅产出文本。
